 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Stephen Curry and the Golden State Warriors host Zion Williamson and the New Orleans Pelicans on Monday during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 Golden State enters the matchup on a hot streak, with head coach Steve Kerr leading the team to seven straight victories. The Warriors' most recent victory was over Paolo Banchero and the Orlando Magic, 126-119, on Saturday. Guard Curry currently leads the team in points per game at 31.3. Rookie forward Yaxel Lendeborg leads the team in rebounds at 7.2, while forward Draymond Green averages a team-high 7.8 assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Pelicans vs Warriors TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Time: 10 p.m. ET
 Venue: Chase Center, San Francisco
 TV: NBATV, Gulf Coast Sports, DirecTV
 Live stream: Pelicans.com, Sling TV, YouTube TV, Fubo
 Fans can watch the game for free most readily through the Fubo app. Another avenue for fans to watch for free is through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free trial that can be canceled within five days.
 The Pelicans lost their most recent matchup against the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday, 139-123. Center Williamson scored 25 points, while forward Trey Murphy scored a team-high 26 points and secured a team-high seven rebounds. Guard Jeremiah Fears scored 25 points while securing six rebounds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For New Orleans, forward Trendon Watford (ankle), forward Trey Murphy III (knee) and center Yves Missi (knee) are all out for the game. For Golden State, guard Gary Payton II (knee) and forward Gui Santos (knee) are both game-time decisions. Guard Will Richard (thumb), center Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and guard Moses Moody (knee) are all out for the game.
